question: Which AI initiative will generate the highest ROI?
restated: Which of the proposed AI initiatives will produce the highest return on investment?
trap: Support automation, usually, followed by sales enablement. Here is a scoring matrix of expected savings against effort.
misses: Each ROI figure is an estimate written by the person who wants the project. The ranking rewards whoever wrote the most optimistic case, and nobody owns the number after launch.

decision.what: How to allocate a limited AI budget and team across competing initiatives.

premises.text: The ROI estimates are reliable enough to rank.
Someone will measure the return after launch.
The initiatives do not compete for the same people.

reframes.question: What will count as return, by when, and who owns the number after launch?
reframes.changes: Turns sponsor estimates into commitments. Initiatives whose sponsors will not own a number drop out on their own.

reframes.question: Which current initiatives should we stop so that any of these can succeed?
reframes.changes: Capacity, not ideas, is usually the constraint. Ranking more work without removing work spreads the team thinner.

reframes.question: Which business problem would we spend this money on if AI did not exist?
reframes.changes: Separates real problems from AI-shaped projects, and points the budget at outcomes.

first.question: What will count as return, by when, and who owns the number?
first.why: A ranking of estimates nobody will be held to is a ranking of optimism.
